svg.title: Ag2Te source-reported cell geometry outline
svg.desc: Author-drawn geometric cell outline from Li et al. 2001 XRD Figure 1A and text. No atomic coordinates or occupancy are provided; outline is not a measured specimen atomic model.

g.text: Monoclinic Ag2Te: a=8.18 Å, b=8.94 Å, c=8.07 Å, β=112.8°
